universityExtra.scholarshipsDesc: TU-Varna offers various scholarship opportunities: Evrika Foundation named scholarships (€3,000/year) for 11 academic fields, Erasmus+ mobility grants (€606-€674/month), National Young Scientists and Postdocs Program, state scholarships for doctoral students, and Smart PHD Lab 5.0 project funding.
universityExtra.evrika: Evrika Foundation: Named scholarships of €3,000/year in 11 fields including Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, and Economics
universityExtra.erasmusGrants: Erasmus+: Mobility grants of €606-€674/month for study or traineeship abroad at 155 partner universities in 47 countries
universityExtra.youngScientists: National Program "Young Scientists and Postdocs – 2": Research funding for early-career researchers
universityExtra.smartPHD: Smart PHD Lab 5.0: PhD scholarships in telecommunications, AI, automation and mechatronics (EU-funded)
universityExtra.stateScholarships: State scholarships for full-time doctoral students with access to the largest technical library in Northeastern Bulgaria
universityExtra.applicationDesc: Admission runs in 5 early stages (October–May) and a main round in June. Apply online at ksp.tu-varna.bg or in person at the Candidate-Student Reception Centre, Mechanical-Technological Faculty, Mon–Thu 8:00–16:30, Fri 9:30–16:30.
universityExtra.earlyStages: 5 early admission stages from October 14 to May 14, 2026
universityExtra.mainRound: Main round: document submission May 18 – June 19, 2026; ranking June 23; enrollment June 23–26
universityExtra.drawingExam: Industrial Design drawing exam: June 22, 2026 (4 hours)
universityExtra.onlineTest: Electronic tests held online every working day at 9:00, 11:30 and 14:00 with prior registration
universityExtra.appFees: Application fee: €9; electronic test/drawing exam: €30; admission with state exam: €20
universityExtra.appDocuments: Required: secondary school diploma (or certificate of completed 1st gymnasium stage) + 11th grade academic report
universityExtra.maritimeMedical: Navigation, Marine Engineering and Ship Electrical Equipment require a medical certificate from Maritime Administration-authorised institutions
universityExtra.masterFeesDesc: Master's semester fees in BGN per program category:
universityExtra.masterSiemens: Siemens PLC Control Technologies: 325 BGN (state-subsidized) / 1,994 BGN (paid)
universityExtra.openDoorsDesc: TU-Varna partners with leading companies for regular Open Doors events, giving students direct access to industry:
universityExtra.siemensHub: Siemens Engineering Hub Varna – Open Doors for AICCS, ITS, Robotics and Software students
universityExtra.mtgDelfin: MTG Delfin Shipyard – Open Doors with paid internship programmes for maritime engineering students
universityExtra.schwarzIT: Schwarz IT (Lidl/Kaufland) – IT internship programmes and collaboration on AI and electric transport
universityExtra.autodesk: Autodesk Authorized Training Centre – AutoCAD, Inventor, Revit and Fusion 360 certification
universityExtra.expressbank: Societe Generale Expressbank – IT department Open Doors for IT students
universityExtra.partnersDesc: TU-Varna has 155 international cooperation agreements from 47 countries and strong industry partnerships including:
universityExtra.industryPartners: Siemens, ABB, Festo, Schneider Electric, National Instruments, Autodesk, Schwarz IT, MTG Delfin
universityExtra.academicPartners: Academic partners via Erasmus+ with 155 universities in 47 countries including Germany, France, UK, Austria, Poland, Romania, Turkey, Greece, South Korea, China and many more
universityExtra.ceepus: CEEPUS network: Central European academic exchange with universities in Hungary, Austria, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Croatia, Serbia, Slovenia
universityExtra.internationalDesc: The International Cooperation and Foreign Students Department (office 326 NUK, email: international@tu-varna.bg) handles foreign student admission. EU/EEA applicants follow similar procedures as Bulgarian citizens with recognized diplomas.
universityExtra.mu_scholarshipsDesc: MU-Varna offers various scholarship opportunities for outstanding students:
universityExtra.mu_excellentScholarships: Excellence scholarships for high academic achievement (up to €1,000/year)
universityExtra.mu_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship at 100+ partner universities
universityExtra.mu_socialScholarships: Social scholarships for students with financial need
universityExtra.mu_doctoralScholarships: Doctoral scholarships for PhD candidates in medical sciences
universityExtra.mu_applicationDesc: Admission to MU-Varna programs is competitive and requires strong academic performance in science subjects.
universityExtra.mu_appBiology: Biology and Chemistry entrance exams for Medicine, Dental Medicine, Pharmacy (BG programs)
universityExtra.mu_appDocuments: Required: secondary school diploma, transcript of records, medical certificate, 4 photos
universityExtra.mu_appOnline: Online application through the MU-Varna registration system at mu-varna.bg
universityExtra.mu_appDeadlines: Main application period: May – September for the academic year starting in October
universityExtra.mu_appInternational: International students: submit diplomas with recognition certificate from the Ministry of Education
universityExtra.mu_appFees: Application fee: €60 (first exam), €40 (each additional exam); €40 for programs without exam
universityExtra.mu_masterFeesDesc: MU-Varna offers integrated Master's programs (Medicine 6 years, Dental Medicine 6 years, Pharmacy 5 years) and postgraduate Master's programs (1-2 years):
universityExtra.mu_integratedMed: Medicine (MD): 6-year integrated Master, taught in Bulgarian or English
universityExtra.mu_integratedDent: Dental Medicine (DMD): 6-year integrated Master, taught in Bulgarian or English
universityExtra.mu_integratedPharm: Pharmacy (MSc): 5-year integrated Master, taught in Bulgarian or English
universityExtra.mu_mph: Public Health (MPH): 2-year postgraduate Master for bachelor holders in health/social sciences
universityExtra.mu_healthMgmt: Health Care Management: 2-year postgraduate Master for health professionals
universityExtra.mu_openDoorsDesc: MU-Varna organizes regular Open Doors events and offers extensive clinical training opportunities:
universityExtra.mu_universityHospital: University Hospital St. Marina – main clinical base with 1,000+ beds for practical training
universityExtra.mu_simulationCenter: Modern Simulation Training Center with high-fidelity mannequins and virtual reality trainers
universityExtra.mu_researchLabs: Research laboratories in molecular biology, pharmacology, public health and more
universityExtra.mu_clinicalRotations: Clinical rotations in partner hospitals across Bulgaria and abroad
universityExtra.mu_partnersDesc: MU-Varna has 100+ international cooperation agreements and active memberships in global networks:
universityExtra.mu_euPartners: Erasmus+ partners in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Greece, Turkey, Poland, Romania, and many more
universityExtra.mu_asphr: Member of ASPHER (Association of Schools of Public Health in the European Region)
universityExtra.mu_who: WHO collaborating activities and participation in global health initiatives
universityExtra.mu_bilateral: Bilateral agreements with universities in Asia, Africa, and the Americas for student and staff exchange
universityExtra.mu_internationalDesc: MU-Varna welcomes over 2,000 international students from 56 countries. The International Relations Department provides dedicated support for foreign students:
universityExtra.mu_visaSupport: Visa and residence permit assistance for non-EU students
universityExtra.mu_dormitories: Student dormitories available for international students at affordable rates
universityExtra.mu_languagePrep: Preparatory language courses in Bulgarian and English (9 months, €5,000)
universityExtra.mu_recognition: Diploma recognition service through the Ministry of Education and Science
universityExtra.ue_scholarshipsDesc: UE-Varna students can access merit-based state scholarships, mobility grants and need-based support:
universityExtra.ue_excellentScholarships: Merit scholarships from the state budget for full-time students with strong academic results (very good grades and above)
universityExtra.ue_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study (min. 3 months) or traineeship (min. 2 months) at partner universities, with no tuition abroad plus a monthly living and travel allowance
universityExtra.ue_socialScholarships: Social scholarships for students from low-income families and special categories
universityExtra.ue_doctoralScholarships: State scholarships for full-time doctoral candidates in economics, management and informatics
universityExtra.ue_applicationDesc: Admission for Bulgarian and EU/EEA applicants is competition-based on secondary-school results; application documents are accepted from 1 May to 30 September.
universityExtra.ue_appEarly: State-subsidised selection closes at the end of June, with ranking results published in late July
universityExtra.ue_appDocuments: Required: secondary-school diploma and supplement, ID/passport copy, application form, motivation letter and photos
universityExtra.ue_appOnline: Apply online through the UE-Varna admission platform or in person at the Information Centre (77 Knyaz Boris I Blvd, Varna)
universityExtra.ue_appMainRound: Ranking score is formed from the diploma average grade, Bulgarian language and mathematics grades, plus one optional matriculation exam (or doubled mathematics)
universityExtra.ue_appFees: Non-EU applicants apply via the Foreign Students Division with legalised, translated diplomas and a NACID recognition certificate
universityExtra.ue_appExams: Programmes taught in English or Russian require a B2-level language certificate; some programmes may include an interview
universityExtra.ue_appInternational: International (non-EU) applicants: submit documents by 30 September and study on a paid basis (€1,350–€1,500 per semester)
universityExtra.ue_masterFeesDesc: Master's semester fees at UE-Varna vary by field and mode of study:
universityExtra.ue_masterRegular: State-subsidised programmes: from €416 to €598 per semester depending on the professional field
universityExtra.ue_masterEnglish: English-taught programmes (e.g. Digital Innovation and Intercultural Business): €1,000 per semester
universityExtra.ue_masterDistance: Part-time / distance learning: €440–€713 per semester; international (non-EU) students €1,600/year (€800 for dual Bulgarian citizens)
universityExtra.ue_openDoorsDesc: UE-Varna links study with practice through its career services, business partnerships and student initiatives:
universityExtra.ue_businessAccelerator: Business incubator and entrepreneurship support helping students develop and launch startup projects
universityExtra.ue_careerCentre: Career Centre organising job fairs, employer meetings and internships with leading companies
universityExtra.ue_uebn: University–business cooperation with 1,800+ corporate and public-administration partners across finance, IT, trade and tourism
universityExtra.ue_alumni: Active alumni community of 155,000+ graduates in Bulgaria and abroad
universityExtra.ue_partnersDesc: UE-Varna cooperates with almost 190 universities and 258 institutions from 45 countries:
universityExtra.ue_erasmusPartners: Erasmus+ partner universities across the EU, Turkey and North Macedonia for student and staff exchange
universityExtra.ue_dukenet: Member of DukeNET – an international network of business and economics universities
universityExtra.ue_businet: Member of BusiNET – a European network for business education and applied research
universityExtra.ue_ceepus: Participation in CEEPUS – the Central European Exchange Programme for University Studies
universityExtra.ue_doubleDegrees: Double-degree and joint programmes with selected European partner universities
universityExtra.ue_magellan: Member of the Magellan Exchange network for international business-student mobility
universityExtra.ue_internationalDesc: UE-Varna welcomes 300+ international students from over 50 countries, supported by a dedicated Foreign Students Division:
universityExtra.ue_visaSupport: Visa and residence-permit assistance for non-EU students (foreign_students@ue-varna.bg)
universityExtra.ue_dormitories: Student dormitories and a campus by the Sea Garden at affordable rates
universityExtra.ue_languageCourses: Preparatory Bulgarian-language course for applicants entering Bulgarian-taught degrees
universityExtra.ue_recognition: Diploma recognition through NACID for applicants with foreign secondary-school diplomas
universityExtra.ue_internationalOffice: International Relations Office coordinating Erasmus+, exchanges and incoming students (int_relations@ue-varna.bg)
universityExtra.na_scholarshipsDesc: As a state military-and-civilian academy, NVNA funds its cadets through the Ministry of Defence and offers Erasmus+ mobility, state merit and social scholarships, and reduced fees for students with Bulgarian roots.
universityExtra.na_militaryCadets: Military cadets are fully funded by the Ministry of Defence — free tuition plus a monthly stipend, board, uniform and accommodation
universityExtra.na_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship at partner maritime universities across Europe
universityExtra.na_stateScholarships: State merit and social scholarships for Bulgarian full-time students based on academic performance
universityExtra.na_dualCitizenship: Students with dual Bulgarian citizenship pay only 50% of the applicable tuition fee
universityExtra.na_doctoralScholarships: State scholarships for full-time doctoral candidates across the academy's 9 PhD programmes
universityExtra.na_applicationDesc: Admission is open to Bulgarian and international applicants. English-taught programmes require proof of English at B2 level; apply online through the academy's admission portal.
universityExtra.na_appBachelor: Bachelor: secondary-school diploma with Maths, English and overall GPA each at least 62% of the maximum grade
universityExtra.na_appEnglish: English proficiency B2 or higher — Cambridge FCE/CAE, IELTS 5.5+, or TOEFL iBT 65+
universityExtra.na_appDeadlineBachelor: Bachelor applications for international students close in mid-August
universityExtra.na_appMaster: Master: a Bachelor degree (240 ECTS) plus B2 English; applications close in mid-September
universityExtra.na_appPrep: A 9-month preparatory language course is available for applicants who need to reach the English requirement
universityExtra.na_appPortal: Apply online at fees.nvna.eu — International Students Office: Int_students@nvna.eu, +359 52 632 015
universityExtra.na_masterFeesDesc: Tuition is fixed by contract for the whole course. Military cadets study free of charge; civilian annual fees are:
universityExtra.na_feeNonEu: Non-EU international students: €3,900 per year (two installments per semester)
universityExtra.na_feeDual: Dual Bulgarian citizenship: 50% of the applicable fee
universityExtra.na_feeContract: Campus dormitory accommodation costs €70 per month including utilities
universityExtra.na_facilitiesDesc: The academy trains cadets and students on a modern, STCW-certified material base:
universityExtra.na_simulators: STCW-certified navigation/bridge, engine-room and GMDSS simulators
universityExtra.na_lngSimulator: A unique LNG-bunkering simulator and a planetarium for astronavigation training
universityExtra.na_cyberCentre: A dedicated Cyber Operations Training Centre for cybersecurity and ICT programmes
universityExtra.na_seaPractice: Supervised sea practice and onboard training on naval and merchant vessels
universityExtra.na_dormitory: Campus library, laboratories and a 200-room student dormitory
universityExtra.na_partnersDesc: NVNA cooperates with naval academies, maritime universities and industry across Europe and beyond:
universityExtra.na_navalAcademies: Partnerships with 10 naval academies in Germany, Greece, Spain, Italy, the UK, Poland, Romania, the USA, Turkey and France
universityExtra.na_maritimeUnis: Maritime university partners including Piri Reis (Istanbul), Constanta Maritime and Rijeka Maritime universities
universityExtra.na_erasmusNetwork: An Erasmus+ network spanning 13+ European higher-education institutions
universityExtra.na_imo: IMO "White List" status and STCW 78/95 compliance, backed by ISO 9001 certification
universityExtra.na_ranking: Ranked among the world's leading maritime schools (2nd–4th of 70 in international assessments)
universityExtra.na_internationalDesc: International students are welcome across the academy's English-taught programmes, with dedicated admission and language support.
universityExtra.na_englishPrograms: Degree programmes delivered entirely in English
universityExtra.na_visaSupport: Admission and visa support through the International Students Office (Int_students@nvna.eu)
universityExtra.na_prepCourse: A 9-month preparatory language course prepares future students for English-taught study
universityExtra.na_foreignTradition: Foreign cadets have trained at the academy since 1953, from more than a dozen countries
universityExtra.na_recognition: Diplomas are internationally recognised under STCW and the IMO White List
universityExtra.vfu_scholarshipsDesc: As a private university, VFU supports students through merit scholarships, tuition discounts and Erasmus+ mobility rather than state grants:
universityExtra.vfu_meritScholarships: Merit (rector's) scholarships and awards for students with excellent academic results
universityExtra.vfu_earlyPaymentDiscount: 5% discount when the full semester fee is paid in advance by the set deadline
universityExtra.vfu_familyDiscount: Tuition discounts for a second family member at VFU and for VFU alumni continuing to a Master's
universityExtra.vfu_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship at partner universities across Europe
universityExtra.vfu_installments: Tuition payable in two installments per semester to ease the financial load
universityExtra.vfu_applicationDesc: Admission for 2026/2027 is open online through the candidate-student portal ksp.vfu.bg, with several entry routes depending on the programme:
universityExtra.vfu_appRoutes: Bachelor entry by secondary-school (matriculation / ДЗИ) results, an entrance exam, or an online competition test
universityExtra.vfu_appArchitecture: Architecture and arts programmes include a drawing or aptitude examination
universityExtra.vfu_appMaster: Master's admission is document-based, after a relevant higher-education degree
universityExtra.vfu_appDocuments: Required: secondary-school diploma (or higher-education diploma for Master's), application form, ID and photos
universityExtra.vfu_appLanguages: Programmes are offered in Bulgarian, English and Turkish, in full-time, part-time or distance form
universityExtra.vfu_appContact: Applications: priem@vfu.bg, +359 52 355 106, Chayka resort, 84 Yanko Slavchev St, Varna
universityExtra.vfu_masterFeesDesc: Master's tuition is charged per semester and varies by faculty and student category (2025/2026):
universityExtra.vfu_feeSocial: Social, Business & Computer Sciences: €664–€1,170 per semester (BG/EU students)
universityExtra.vfu_feeLaw: Law & National Security: from €664 per semester (BG/EU students)
universityExtra.vfu_feeIntl: International (non-EU) students: €1,800 per semester (€2,000 for construction engineering)
universityExtra.vfu_feeDiscount: 5% discount for early full payment; fees are payable in two installments per semester
universityExtra.vfu_campusDesc: VFU's seaside campus in the Chayka resort offers a modern learning environment and student services:
universityExtra.vfu_digitalCentre: Centre for Digital Technologies and modern computer laboratories
universityExtra.vfu_mootCourt: Moot courtroom and legal clinic for Law students
universityExtra.vfu_studios: Architecture and design studios and fine-arts ateliers
universityExtra.vfu_library: University library, Distance Learning Centre and a medical centre
universityExtra.vfu_sportsHousing: Sports facilities, an academic dance theatre and on-campus student accommodation
universityExtra.vfu_partnersDesc: VFU is an active member of international academic networks and cooperates with employers and institutions across the region:
universityExtra.vfu_eua: Member of the European University Association (EUA), holding the Erasmus Charter for Higher Education
universityExtra.vfu_erasmusNetwork: Erasmus+ exchange with 100+ partner universities across Europe
universityExtra.vfu_qualityLabels: Holder of the ECTS and Diploma Supplement labels and the HR Excellence in Research award
universityExtra.vfu_employers: Cooperation with courts, public institutions and companies for student internships
universityExtra.vfu_smolyan: A branch in Smolyan extends access to VFU programmes beyond Varna
universityExtra.vfu_internationalDesc: VFU welcomes international students from across the world through its International Admissions Centre:
universityExtra.vfu_englishTurkish: Bachelor's and Master's programmes taught in English and Turkish
universityExtra.vfu_visaSupport: Admission, visa and residence-permit support for non-EU students (priem@vfu.bg)
universityExtra.vfu_prepCourse: Preparatory Bulgarian-language course for students entering Bulgarian-taught degrees
universityExtra.vfu_housing: On-campus student accommodation at affordable rates
universityExtra.vfu_recognition: Recognition of foreign secondary-school and higher-education diplomas
universityExtra.vum_scholarshipsDesc: VUM keeps tuition affordable and offers several forms of financial support so that motivation and talent are rewarded from the first year:
universityExtra.vum_newStudents: New bachelor students can win a merit scholarship of up to €250 for the first year by passing a motivational interview and an English test with a score above 80%
universityExtra.vum_partnerCompany: Partner-company scholarships of €250–€1,000 for the first year (requires an English certificate — IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, CAE or SAT — or a strong state matriculation result)
universityExtra.vum_meritSports: Scholarships for excellent academic results, extracurricular activity and sporting achievement for students after the first year, and scholarships for Master's students
universityExtra.vum_earlyDiscount: 10% early-admission discount and a jubilee "30 Years VUM" campaign
universityExtra.vum_referFriend: "Refer a Friend" reward programme for students who bring new applicants
universityExtra.vum_studentLoans: State-guaranteed student loans (under-35s, EU/EEA citizens, interest capped at 7%) with a one-year grace period after graduation
universityExtra.vum_applicationDesc: Admission is open online through vum.bg, with September and February intakes for bachelor's and master's programmes:
universityExtra.vum_appEnglish: Programmes are taught in English — applicants sit an English-language test or provide a recognised certificate (IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, CAE, SAT)
universityExtra.vum_appIntakes: Two intakes per year: September (standard cycle) and February
universityExtra.vum_appDualDiploma: Eligible students graduate with both a Bulgarian VUM diploma and a British degree from Cardiff Metropolitan University
universityExtra.vum_appDocuments: Required: secondary-school diploma (or higher-education diploma for Master's), application form, ID/passport and photos
universityExtra.vum_appNacid: Foreign secondary-school diplomas require a NACID recognition procedure (€100)
universityExtra.vum_appOnline: Apply online at vum.bg/bg/kandidatstvai-onlain — admissions@vum.bg (application fee €120 EU / €150 non-EU)
universityExtra.vum_masterFeesDesc: Tuition is charged per semester and depends on the programme, language and student category (2025/2026):
universityExtra.vum_feeCulinary: Culinary Arts bachelor: €1,500 per semester (EU/EEA) · €2,400 (non-EU); uniforms & knives fee €725
universityExtra.vum_feeMasters: MBA & International Tourism master: €1,500 per semester (EU/EEA) · €1,950–€2,400 (non-EU), lower in later semesters
universityExtra.vum_feeCardiff: Cardiff Metropolitan University diploma registration: €475 per semester (final two semesters for bachelor's, semesters 1–3 for master's)
universityExtra.vum_campusDesc: VUM's Varna campus offers a modern, practice-oriented learning environment, with additional teaching locations in Sofia and Dobrich:
universityExtra.vum_culinaryStudios: Professional training kitchens and restaurant studios at the Institute of Culinary Arts
universityExtra.vum_itLabs: Computer laboratories and an Online Campus (onlinecampus.vum.bg) for blended and distance learning
universityExtra.vum_library: Library and information complex, Institute for Modern Education and a Research Institute with a Centre for Innovation in Tourism
universityExtra.vum_careerCentre: Career centre with paid-internship placement and a strong "business supports talent" employer network
universityExtra.vum_accommodation: Student accommodation and welfare services (accommodation reservation deposit €300 where applicable)
universityExtra.vum_partnersDesc: VUM's dual-diploma model rests on strong strategic partnerships and an international academic network:
universityExtra.vum_cardiff: Cardiff Metropolitan University (UK) — British bachelor's and master's diplomas awarded alongside the VUM degree
universityExtra.vum_ucBirmingham: University College Birmingham (UK) — partner in hospitality and culinary education
universityExtra.vum_stenden: Stenden University of Applied Sciences (Netherlands) and the Business & Hotel Management School (Switzerland)
universityExtra.vum_globalNetwork: Cooperation with 100+ renowned institutions across Europe, Asia and South America
universityExtra.vum_erasmus: Ranked No.1 in the world for student mobility by U-Multirank for four consecutive years, with a full Erasmus+ programme
universityExtra.vum_internationalDesc: As an international business school with students from more than 45 countries, VUM offers dedicated support for foreign students:
universityExtra.vum_englishTaught: All degree programmes are taught entirely in English in small, multicultural groups
universityExtra.vum_visaSupport: Admission and visa support for non-EU students (visa deposit €500 where applicable) — admissions@vum.bg
universityExtra.vum_prep: English-language testing and preparation, plus study-abroad semesters with partner universities worldwide
universityExtra.vum_multicultural: A diverse, multicultural campus ranked first in Central & Eastern Europe for international orientation (U-Multirank)
universityExtra.vum_recognition: Dual Bulgarian and British (Cardiff Metropolitan University) diplomas recognised internationally
universityExtra.su_scholarshipsDesc: As a state university, Sofia University keeps tuition low for Bulgarian and EU students and offers a range of merit- and need-based support:
universityExtra.su_meritScholarships: Merit scholarships from the state budget for full-time students with a strong grade-point average, plus special and named (donor) scholarships
universityExtra.su_socialScholarships: Social (need-based) scholarships, support for students from vulnerable groups, and one-off assistance in special circumstances
universityExtra.su_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship abroad at hundreds of partner universities, plus Transform4Europe alliance opportunities
universityExtra.su_phdScholarships: State scholarships for full-time doctoral candidates and paid participation in national and European research projects
universityExtra.su_studentLoans: State-guaranteed, low-interest student loans for Bulgarian and EU students under the Student and Doctoral Loans Act
universityExtra.su_applicationDesc: Admission is organised by the university each summer, with separate tracks for Bulgarian/EU and non-EU applicants:
universityExtra.su_appEuExam: Bulgarian and EU applicants are ranked by a composite score from state matriculation (ДЗИ) exams and/or Sofia University entrance examinations
universityExtra.su_appNonEu: Non-EU applicants are admitted on the basis of their documents, provided the relevant grade is at least 62% of the maximum in their country's system
universityExtra.su_appMedicine: Medicine and Pharmacy applicants sit competitive entrance exams in Biology and Chemistry (with English for the English-taught programmes)
universityExtra.su_appDocuments: Required documents include the secondary-school diploma (with NACID recognition for foreign diplomas), an application form, ID/passport and a medical certificate
universityExtra.su_appDeadlines: Applications are typically submitted from June to August, with ranking rounds in July–September for the autumn start

1.name: Technical University
1.description: Leading engineering and technology programs with state-of-the-art research facilities.
1.longDescription:
Technical University of Varna is the second-largest state technical university in Bulgaria, founded in 1962. It holds institutional accreditation with the highest rating of Very Good for a six-year period, awarded by the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA). It is the first university in Bulgaria to receive institutional accreditation from the European University Association. The university is certified under ISO 9001:2008 and has an extensive international network with 155 partner universities from 47 countries through Erasmus+ and other programmes.

The university comprises 4 faculties — Mechanical Engineering (MTF), Shipbuilding (KF), Electrical Engineering (EF), and Computer Systems & Automation (FITA) — along with the Dobrudzha Technological College in Dobrich, an in-house College of TU-Varna, a Research Institute, and a High Technology Park. The campus spans 200 decares and features over 230 modernly equipped laboratories, 50+ lecture halls, a sports complex, 6 student dormitories, a canteen, library, career centre, CISCO Academy, Maritime Qualification Centre, Autodesk Authorized Training Centre, and a Doctoral Centre.

Over 60,000 students have graduated since its founding across 33 bachelor's and 92 master's programmes and doctoral programmes. The university is a partner of leading companies including Siemens, ABB, Festo, Schneider Electric, National Instruments, Autodesk, Schwarz IT, and MTG Delfin shipyard.

Several programmes are offered tuition-free: Electric Power Engineering, Power Supply & Electrical Equipment, Naval Architecture & Marine Technology, and Heat Power Engineering & Investment Design. Rector: Prof. Dr. Dragomir Plamenov.

2.name: Medical University
2.description: Bulgaria's leading medical university with top-ranked clinical training and research programs.
2.longDescription:
Medical University of Varna (Prof. Dr. Paraskev Stoyanov) is a leading Bulgarian medical university founded in 1961. It is accredited with the highest rating by the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA) and holds the EFQM Excellence Model recognition. The university comprises 4 faculties — Medicine, Dental Medicine, Pharmacy, and Public Health — along with the Medical College - Varna and affiliates in Shumen, Veliko Tarnovo, and Burgas.

The university has over 7,000 students, 2,000 of whom are international students from 56 countries. The campus features modern simulation centers, clinical bases at the University Hospital St. Marina, research laboratories, a library, sports facilities, and student dormitories.

International students can study Medicine, Dental Medicine, and Pharmacy in English. Nursing and Midwifery are tuition-free. The university has 100+ international partner institutions and active Erasmus+ exchange programs.

Over 50,000 alumni have graduated since its founding. Rector: Prof. Dr. Valentin Ignatov.

3.name: University of Economics – Varna
3.description: Bulgaria's oldest specialised economics university, offering business, finance, IT, management and tourism programs by the Black Sea.
3.longDescription:
The University of Economics – Varna (UE-Varna) is one of Bulgaria's oldest and most prestigious higher schools of economics, founded on 14 May 1920 as the Higher School of Commerce. It is the second economics-focused university established in Bulgaria and a landmark of the city of Varna — its central building is a cultural-heritage site next to the Sea Garden and was awarded the Building of the Year prize in 2015. The university is accredited by the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA) and is the only Bulgarian higher-education institution certified with the European Solidarity Corps Programme Quality Label. It is featured in the Times Higher Education World University Impact Rankings.

The university is organised into 4 faculties — Finance and Accounting, Economics, Information Technologies (Informatics) and Management — together with the College of Tourism – Varna and a Department of Language Learning. It offers 28 bachelor's programmes (23 in Bulgarian, 3 in English and 1 in Russian), 29 master's programmes (25 in Bulgarian, 4 in English), 16 doctoral programmes and 20+ post-graduate qualification programmes.

Today UE-Varna has over 7,500 Bulgarian and international students taught by more than 230 full-time lecturers, including 100+ professors and associate professors. The campus offers 110+ lecture and study halls, a 600-seat Aula auditorium and a library of over 350,000 volumes. More than 155,000 economists and professionals have graduated from the university over its century of history.

The university maintains an extensive international network of almost 190 partner universities and cooperation with 258 institutions from 45 countries through Erasmus+, CEEPUS, DukeNET, BusiNET, the Magellan Exchange and EEA/Norway grants, and works with over 1,800 corporate and public-administration partners. Rector: Prof. Dr. Evgeni Stanimirov.

4.name: Naval University
4.description: Bulgaria's oldest maritime school — training naval officers and merchant-marine professionals since 1881.
4.longDescription:
The Nikola Vaptsarov Naval Academy is Bulgaria's oldest maritime and technical school, founded in 1881 as a Maritime School and named in 1949 after the poet Nikola Vaptsarov, a 1926 graduate. It is the country's most authoritative centre for maritime education, training both military naval officers and civilian merchant-marine professionals.

The academy is organised into two faculties — the Faculty of Navigation and the Faculty of Engineering — each with six departments, supported by a Department of Postgraduate Training and Distance Learning, a Professional Junior-Officers' College, a Cyber Operations Training Centre and a research section. It offers 12 bachelor's, 13 master's and 9 doctoral programmes, with around 3,000 students and cadets.

Training complies with the IMO STCW 78/95 convention; the academy has been on the IMO "White List" since 2000, is ISO 9001 certified and received full university accreditation in 2001. It is consistently ranked among the world's leading maritime universities (placed 2nd–4th among 70 institutions in international assessments). Facilities include unique navigation, engine-room and LNG-bunkering simulators, a planetarium, laboratories and a campus dormitory.

Degree programmes are offered in English, with a 9-month preparatory language course available. Military cadets are fully funded by the Ministry of Defence, while civilian tuition ranges from €2,750/year (EU) to €3,900/year (non-EU). Rector: Flotilla Admiral Prof. Kalin Kalinov.

5.name: Varna Free University
5.description: Bulgaria's largest private university — law, economics, IT, psychology, security and architecture by the Black Sea.
5.longDescription:
Varna Free University "Chernorizets Hrabar" (VFU) is the largest and most established private university in Bulgaria, founded in 1991 and granted full higher-education status in 1995. It is named after Chernorizets Hrabar, the medieval Bulgarian monk and writer. The university holds its third institutional accreditation from the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA) for the maximum six-year period, with a score of 9.12 out of 10, and is an active member of the European University Association (EUA) with the Erasmus Charter for Higher Education, ECTS and Diploma Supplement labels and the HR Excellence in Research award.

The university is organised into three faculties — the Faculty of Social, Business and Computer Sciences (economics, administration and management, psychology, informatics and computer science), the Faculty of Law (law, national security and public order) and the Faculty of Architecture (architecture, construction engineering, fine arts, and music and dance) — together with a branch in Smolyan and a Department of Foreign Language Teaching and Postgraduate Qualification.

VFU offers more than 60 bachelor's and master's programmes and 29 doctoral programmes, taught in Bulgarian, English and Turkish, in full-time, part-time and distance-learning formats. Over the last three decades more than 30,000 students have graduated. The seaside campus in the Chayka resort features modern lecture halls and computer laboratories, a moot courtroom, design and architecture studios, a library, a Centre for Digital Technologies, a medical centre, sports facilities and student accommodation.

Tuition for Bulgarian and EU students ranges from about €848 to €1,354 per semester depending on the programme, while international (non-EU) students pay €1,600–€1,800 per semester for bachelor's and €1,800–€2,000 for master's programmes. Rector: Prof. Dr. Petar Hristov.

6.name: University of Management
6.description: International, English-taught business school in Varna offering dual Bulgarian–British (Cardiff Met) degrees in business, tourism, IT and culinary arts.
6.longDescription:
The University of Management (VUM) in Varna is an international business school and one of Bulgaria's most internationally recognised higher-education institutions. Founded in 1996 as a college of tourism and renamed from International College – Albena in 2015, it marks 30 years in 2026. Students from more than 45 countries study business, marketing, information technology and computer science, tourism, hotel management and culinary arts in a multicultural, English-language environment.

VUM is accredited by the Bulgarian National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA) in the professional fields of Administration and Management, Economics, Tourism, Informatics and Computer Science, Pedagogy of Teaching and Food Technologies, and offers bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes through its Faculty of Business.

The university's flagship is its dual-diploma model: bachelor's and master's programmes are taught entirely in English and lead to both a Bulgarian VUM diploma and a British degree from strategic partner Cardiff Metropolitan University, without the usual requirement to spend a semester abroad. VUM also cooperates with University College Birmingham, Stenden University (Netherlands), the Business & Hotel Management School (Switzerland) and more than 100 institutions across Europe, Asia and South America.

VUM holds 4 Palmes of Excellence from Eduniversal, placing it among the world's top 200 business schools and making it the only Bulgarian institution at this level. It has been ranked No.1 in the world for student mobility by U-Multirank for four consecutive years; its Master in International Tourism is ranked 10th worldwide and its MBA 5th in Central and Eastern Europe by Eduniversal Best Masters. President: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Todor Radev. Rector: Prof. Dr. Krasimira Staneva.

7.name: Sofia University
7.description: Bulgaria's oldest and largest university (est. 1888) — a comprehensive research university in the heart of Sofia with 16 faculties spanning law, sciences, humanities, economics and medicine.
7.longDescription:
Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski" is the oldest and largest higher-education institution in Bulgaria, founded on 1 October 1888 and established as a university in 1904. Named after the medieval scholar St. Kliment Ohridski, it is the country's leading centre of teaching and research and is consistently ranked the No. 1 university in Bulgaria.

The university is organised into 16 faculties — Law, Philosophy, History, Classical and Modern Philology, Slavic Studies, Education, Educational Studies and the Arts, Journalism and Mass Communication, Theology, Economics and Business Administration, Mathematics and Informatics, Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy, Biology, Geology and Geography, and Medicine — together with three departments. It offers more than 100 bachelor's and over 200 master's programmes, plus doctoral training, in Bulgarian and in English and other foreign languages.

Today over 20,000 students study at the university, taught by around 1,700 academic staff. Its landmark Rectorate on Tsar Osvoboditel Boulevard — built between 1924 and 1934 with a donation from the brothers Evlogi and Hristo Georgiev — spans more than 18,000 m² with 324 rooms. The university also runs the largest university library in the country, a botanical garden, observatories and modern research institutes, including INSAIT, which won Bulgaria's first European Research Council grant.

Sofia University maintains a wide international network through Erasmus+, the Transform4Europe alliance and hundreds of bilateral agreements, and its alumni include Bulgarian presidents, prime ministers, academicians and cultural figures. Bulgarian and EU students study on state-subsidised or paid places, while foreign students pay tuition set per programme; Medicine and Pharmacy are also offered as English-taught degrees. Rector: Prof. Dr. Georgi Valchev.

8.name: Technical University of Sofia
8.description: Bulgaria's largest and foremost university for engineering and technology (est. 1945) — computing, electronics, electrical, mechanical and industrial engineering, with English, German and French-taught programs.
8.longDescription:
The Technical University of Sofia (TU-Sofia) is the largest and most prestigious higher school of engineering and technology in Bulgaria, founded on 15 October 1945 as the State Polytechnic and granted its current university status in 1995. It is the country's leading centre for training engineers and a founding member of the European University of Technology (EUt+) alliance.

The university is organised into 17 faculties based in Sofia, Plovdiv and Sliven, including specialised foreign-language faculties that teach engineering entirely in German (FDIBA), English (ELFE) and French. Its Sofia faculties cover Automation, Computer Systems and Technologies, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Transport, Management, and Applied Mathematics and Informatics, together with two colleges and vocational schools.

TU-Sofia has around 11,000 students — some 8,800 bachelor's, 1,900 master's and 500 doctoral students — across a wide range of engineering, computing and management programmes, many delivered in partnership with leading technology companies. Facilities include a High-Technology Business Incubator and Technology Park, modern laboratories, a central scientific-technical library, a sports complex and student dormitories in the Studentski Grad campus.

The university maintains extensive international cooperation through the EUt+ alliance, Erasmus+ and hundreds of partnerships, and works closely with industry — Bosch, SAP, VMware, Festo, Siemens and others — which sponsor scholarships, laboratories and internships. Bulgarian and EU students study on state-subsidised or paid places, while foreign students can study in Bulgarian, English, German or French. Rector: Prof. Dr. Georgi Venkov.

9.name: University of National and World Economy
9.description: Bulgaria's oldest and largest university of economics and business (est. 1920) — economics, finance, management, informatics, international relations and law, in the heart of Sofia.
9.longDescription:
The University of National and World Economy (UNWE) is the oldest and largest higher school of economics and business in Bulgaria and South-Eastern Europe, founded in 1920 as the Free University of Political and Economic Sciences. After several transformations it took its present name in 1990 and is today the country's leading centre for economic, business and administrative education, ranked first in Bulgaria in its professional fields.

The university is organised into 8 faculties — General Economics, Finance and Accountancy, Business, Economics of Infrastructure, Management and Administration, International Economics and Politics, Applied Informatics and Statistics, and Law. It offers 53 bachelor's, 90 master's and 45 doctoral programmes, including majors taught entirely in English, and holds the highest institutional accreditation from the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency.

UNWE has around 20,000 students on its campus in the Studentski Grad district of Sofia. The 41,000 m² complex features 120 auditoriums and 367 study rooms, a modern library, an inter-university Career Development Centre, sports facilities and student dormitories for nearly 5,000 students.

The university is a member of the ENGAGE.EU European University alliance and cooperates with 187 international and 221 local partners through Erasmus+ and joint programmes. Its alumni include five Bulgarian prime ministers, IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva and many leading economists and public figures. Bulgarian and EU students study on state-subsidised or paid places, while foreign students can study in Bulgarian or English. Rector: Prof. Dr. Dimitar Dimitrov.
